# Compatibility

The workflows do not name an agent: `integration` defaults to Spec Kit's
`auto` sentinel and resolves to whichever integration the project was
initialized with. This table says what has actually been exercised.

| Capability | claude | opencode |
|---|---|---|
| **install** — the bundle installs from a catalog | yes (2) | yes (3) |
| **commands** — every declared command lands where the integration reads it | yes (3) | yes (1) |
| **workflows** — the installed workflows resolve | yes (2) | yes (1) |
| **overlays** — a project overlay survives update, reinstall, and removal | not tested | yes (5) |
| **monorepo** — two members of one repository stay independent | not tested | yes (2) |

## What no integration claims

- **workflow execution** — No integration has had a workflow run end to end *in the suite*. Every row above is installation, layout, or resolution. One has now run outside it: lifecycle-greenfield-bootstrap completed under claude during the P13 greenfield pilot, recorded in docs/evidence/pilot-greenfield.md. That is evidence, not a claimed row, because a pilot is one run by one operator and a row here means the suite reproduces it.
